data.exact_reserve_text: During 2020, gross ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2018 and prior) increased by $0.6m ($1.9m net of reinsurance). The older years (2017 & prior) have seen deteriorations coming primarily from the Casualty division, but also PFR and Aviation to a smaller extent, in respect of late deteriorating large losses. This has been offset by better than expected experience on 2018 from some of the shorter tailed lines within the Technical Risks division and Accident & Health division.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a small adverse prior-year reserve movement: gross ultimate claims for prior underwriting years (2018 and earlier) increased by $0.6m (strengthening). The deterioration was driven primarily by older Casualty exposures with additional smaller adverse movements in Property (PFR) and Aviation due to late-developing large losses, partially offset by favourable development on 2018 in shorter-tailed Technical Risks and Accident & Health.
raw_causal_phrases: During 2020, gross ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2018 and prior) increased by $0.6m ($1.9m net of reinsurance).
The older years (2017 & prior) have seen deteriorations coming primarily from the Casualty division, but also PFR and Aviation to a smaller extent, in respect of late deteriorating large losses.
This has been offset by better than expected experience on 2018 from some of the shorter tailed lines within the Technical Risks division and Accident & Health division.

Whilst COVID-19 contributes additional uncertainties to the Syndicate's claim reserves, we do not expect these to have a significant impact on Syndicate 1919. The Syndicate considers its direct COVID-19 claims exposure at this stage to be less than $2m net of reinsurance

data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are taken from the report denominated in USD ($000). 'opening_reserves_gbp_m' and other '_gbp_m' fields are provided in the report's native currency (USD) converted to millions. Prior-year development: explicit gross movement stated in narrative: "gross ultimate claims ... increased by $0.6m" (page 50) - used as authoritative gross PYD. Claims development triangle is present in the report but its printed layout in the PDF extract was difficult to reliably parse into full development rows; therefore the triangle object is flagged but detailed rows are not extracted here.
